# 2 Kings Chapter 19 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 240v–241v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/2KI_019_page_479.jpg, 2KI_019_page_480.jpg, 2KI_019_page_481.jpg

---

**19:1** And-it-was when-the-king Chizkiyahu heard, and-he-tore [vayiqra'] his-garments and-covered-himself [vayitkass] with-sackcloth [saq], and-came [vayavo'] into-the-house of-YHWH.

**19:2** And-he-sent Elyaqim who [was] over the-house, and-Shevnah the-scribe, and-the-elders of-the-priests [ziqney ha-kohanim], covered [mithkassim] with-sackcloth, to-Yesha'yahu the-prophet, son of-Amots.

**19:3** And-they-said to-him: Thus says Chizkiyahu: A-day of-distress [tsarah] and-rebuke [tokhechah] and-contempt [ne'atsah] [is] this day, for the-children [banim] have-come to-the-birth-opening [mashber], and-there-is-no strength [koach] to-give-birth [le-ledah].

**19:4** Perhaps [ulay] YHWH your-God will-hear [yishma'] all the-words of-the-Rav-Shakeh, whom his-master the-king of-Ashur sent to-reproach [le-charef] the-living God [elohim chayim], and-will-rebuke [ve-hokhiach] the-words that YHWH your-God has-heard. And-lift-up [ve-nasa'ta] a-prayer [tefillah] for-the-remnant [ha-she'erit] that-is-found [ha-nimtsa'ah].

**19:5** And-came the-servants ['avdey] of-the-king Chizkiyahu to Yesha'yahu.

**19:6** And-said to-them Yesha'yahu: Thus you-shall-say to your-master: Thus says YHWH: Do-not fear [al tira'] from-the-words that you-have-heard, with-which the-servants [na'arey] of-the-king of-Ashur have-blasphemed [giddefu] me.

**19:7** Behold, I-am-putting [noten] in-him a-spirit [ruach], and-he-shall-hear [ve-shama'] a-report [shemu'ah] and-shall-return [ve-shav] to-his-land, and-I-will-cause-him-to-fall [ve-hippaltiv] by-the-sword [ba-cherev] in-his-land.

**19:8** And-returned the-Rav-Shakeh and-found the-king of-Ashur fighting [nilcham] against Livnah, for he-had-heard that he-had-departed [nasa'] from-Lakhish.

**19:9** And-he-heard concerning Tirhaqah king of-Kush, saying: Behold, he-has-gone-out [yatsa'] to-fight [le-hillachem] with-you. And-he-sent-again [vayashov vayishlach] messengers [mal'akhim] to Chizkiyahu, saying:

**19:10** Thus you-shall-say to Chizkiyahu king of-Yehudah, saying: Let-not your-God deceive-you [yashshi'akha], the-one in-whom you-are-trusting [boteach], saying: Yerushalayim will-not be-given [lo tinnathen] into-the-hand of-the-king of-Ashur.

**19:11** Behold, you have-heard [shamata] what the-kings of-Ashur have-done to-all the-lands, to-devote-them-to-destruction [le-hachrimam]. And-you, will-you-be-delivered [tinnatsel]?

**19:12** Did the-gods of-the-nations deliver-them [hittsilu otam], whom my-fathers destroyed [shichatu] — Gozan and-Charan and-Retseph and-the-sons of-Eden who [were] in-Tel-Assar?

**19:13** Where [is] the-king of-Chamat and-the-king of-Arpad, and-the-king of-the-city [ir] of-Sepharvaim, Hena and-Ivvah?

**19:14** And-took [vayiqqach] Chizkiyahu the-letters [ha-sefarim] from-the-hand of-the-messengers and-read-them [vayiqra'em], and-went-up [vaya'al] Chizkiyahu [to] the-house of-YHWH and-spread-it [vayifreshehu] before YHWH.

**19:15** And-prayed [vayitpallel] Chizkiyahu before YHWH and-said: YHWH, God of-Yisra'el, sitting [yoshev] [upon] the-cherubim [ha-keruvim], you [are] he, the-God [ha-elohim], you-alone [levaddekha], to-all the-kingdoms [mamlekhot] of-the-earth [ha-arets]. You made [asita] the-heavens and-the-earth.

**19:16** Incline [hatteh], YHWH, your-ear [oznekha] and-hear [u-shema']. Open [peqach], YHWH, your-eyes [eynekha] and-see [u-re'eh]. And-hear the-words of-Sancheriv that he-sent to-reproach [le-charef] the-living God.

**19:17** Truly [omnah], YHWH, the-kings of-Ashur have-laid-waste [hecherevihu] the-nations and-their-lands,

**19:18** and-have-given [ve-natenu] their-gods into-the-fire, for they-are-not gods [lo elohim hem] but [ki im] the-work of-human hands [ma'aseh yedey adam], wood [ets] and-stone [even], and-they-destroyed-them [vaye'abbedum].

**19:19** And-now, YHWH our-God, save-us [hoshi'enu], please, from-his-hand, and-let-know [ve-yede'u] all the-kingdoms of-the-earth that you [are] YHWH, God [elohim], you-alone [levaddekha].

**19:20** And-sent Yesha'yahu son of-Amots to Chizkiyahu, saying: Thus says YHWH God of-Yisra'el: That which you-prayed [hitpallalta] to-me concerning Sancheriv king of-Ashur — I-have-heard [shamati].

**19:21** This [is] the-word [ha-davar] that YHWH has-spoken [dibber] concerning-him: She-despises-you [bazah lekha], she-mocks-you [la'agah lekha], the-virgin daughter of-Tsiyon [betulat bat tsiyyon]. Behind-you [acharekha] she-shakes [heni'ah] [her] head, the-daughter of-Yerushalayim.

**19:22** Whom have-you-reproached [cherafta] and-blasphemed [giddafta]? And-against-whom have-you-raised [harimota] a-voice [qol] and-lifted [vatissa'] your-eyes [eynekha] on-high [marom]? Against the-Holy-One [qedosh] of-Yisra'el!

**19:23** By-the-hand of-your-messengers you-have-reproached the-Lord [adonay], and-you-said: With-the-multitude [be-rov] of-my-chariots [rikhbi] I have-gone-up [aliti] the-height [merom] of-the-mountains [harim], the-flanks [yarkhetey] of-the-Levanon, and-I-will-cut-down [ve-ekhrot] the-tallness [qomat] of-its-cedars ['arazav], the-choicest [mivchar] of-its-cypresses [beroshav], and-I-will-enter the-lodging [melon] of-its-farthest-reach [qitsoh], the-forest [ya'ar] of-its-garden [karmelo].

**19:24** I have-dug [qarti] and-drunk foreign [zarim] waters, and-I-will-dry-up [ve-achariv] with-the-sole of-my-feet [be-khaf pe'amay] all the-streams [ye'orey] of-Matsor [Egypt].

**19:25** Have-you-not heard [ha-lo shamata]? From-long-ago [le-me-rachoq] I-made-it [asitihah], from-days of-old [mi-mey qedem] I-formed-it [yetsartihah]. Now I-have-brought-it [havi'tihah], and-it-shall-be for-making-desolate [le-hashshot] fortified cities [arey betsurat] [into] ruined heaps [gallim nitstsim].

**19:26** And-their-inhabitants [yoshveihen], short of-hand [qitsrey yad], were-dismayed [chattu] and-ashamed [vavoshu]. They-were the-grass of-the-field [esev ha-sadeh] and-the-greenness of-vegetation [yeraq deshe'], the-grass of-rooftops [chatir gaggot] and-scorched-grain [u-shedmah] before the-standing-grain [qamah].

**19:27** And-your-sitting [shivtekha] and-your-going-out [tse'tekha] and-your-coming-in [vo'ekha] I-know [yadati], and-your-raging [hitraggazekha] against-me.

**19:28** Because of-your-raging [hitraggazekha] against-me, and-your-arrogance [sha'anankha] has-come-up into-my-ears, and-I-will-put [ve-samti] my-hook [chachhi] in-your-nose [be-appekha] and-my-bit [u-mitiggi] in-your-lips [be-sefateykha], and-I-will-turn-you-back [va-hashivotikha] by-the-way [ba-derekh] that you-came [bata] by-it.

**19:29** And-this [shall be] the-sign [ha-ot] for-you: eat [akhol] this-year the-self-sown [safiach], and-in-the-second year the-aftergrowth [sachish], and-in-the-third year sow [zir'u] and-reap [u-qtsuru] and-plant [ve-nit'u] vineyards [keramim] and-eat their-fruit [piryam].

**19:30** And-the-escaped [peletat] of-the-house of-Yehudah that-remains [ha-nish'arah] shall-add [ve-yosefah] root [shoresh] downward [le-mattah] and-bear fruit [u-fasah feri] upward [le-ma'lah].

**19:31** For from-Yerushalayim shall-go-forth [tetse'] a-remnant [she'erit], and-an-escaped-group [peletah] from-Mount [me-har] Tsiyon. The-zeal [qin'at] of-YHWH [of] hosts [tseva'ot] shall-do this.

**19:32** Therefore thus says YHWH concerning the-king of-Ashur: He-shall-not come [lo yavo'] to this city, and-shall-not shoot [yiyreh] there an-arrow [chets], and-shall-not come-before-it [yeqaddemenah] [with] a-shield [magen], and-shall-not pour [yishpokh] against-it a-siege-ramp [solelah].

**19:33** By-the-way that he-came, by-it he-shall-return [yashuv], and-to this city he-shall-not come [lo yavo'], declares [ne'um] YHWH.

**19:34** And-I-will-defend [ve-gannoti] upon this city to-save-it [le-hoshi'ah], for-my-sake [le-ma'ani] and-for-the-sake of-David my-servant ['avdi].

**19:35** And-it-was in-that night [ba-laylah ha-hu'], and-went-out [vayetse'] the-angel [mal'akh] of-YHWH and-struck [vayakkeh] in-the-camp [ba-machaneh] of-Ashur a-hundred and-eighty-five thousand [me'ah u-shemonim va-chamishah elef]. And-they-rose-early [vayashkimu] in-the-morning, and-behold — all-of-them [kullam] [were] dead [metim] corpses [pegarim].

**19:36** And-departed [vayissa'] and-went [vayelekh] and-returned [vayashov] Sancheriv king of-Ashur, and-dwelt [vayeshev] in-Nineveh [Ninveh].

**19:37** And-it-was, he [was] bowing-down [mishtachaveh] in-the-house of-Nisrokh his-god, and-Adrammelekh and-Shar'etser his-sons [banav] struck-him [hikkuhu] with-the-sword [ba-cherev], and-they fled [nasu] to-the-land of-Ararat. And-became-king [vayimlokh] Esar-Chaddon his-son in-his-place [tachtav].

## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.3 — *mashber*:** "Birth-opening" — the word refers to the cervical opening during childbirth. Hezekiah uses a metaphor of crisis: the moment of birth has arrived, but there is no strength to deliver. The nation is at the breaking point, caught between agony and deliverance.

**v.14 — "spread it before YHWH":** Hezekiah physically lays the letter open before YHWH in the temple — not reading it aloud, but presenting it visually, as if placing evidence before a judge. This is one of the most striking prayer gestures in the Old Testament.

**v.21 — *betulat bat tsiyyon*:** "Virgin daughter Zion" — a personification of Jerusalem as an unconquered maiden. She "despises" and "mocks" Sennacherib, shaking her head behind him as he retreats. The poetry is taunt-song: Zion laughs at the world's greatest empire.

**v.25-26 — YHWH's counter-speech:** YHWH reveals that Assyria's conquests were never Sennacherib's own achievement — "from long ago I made it, from days of old I formed it." Sennacherib is not the conqueror; he is the instrument. Even his greatest victories were YHWH's plan. The nations fell not because Sennacherib was strong but because YHWH ordained it.

**v.28 — "hook in your nose":** The imagery is of a captured animal — or a captive king led by a nose-ring. Sennacherib, who leads nations in chains, will himself be led like a beast. The reversal is complete: the captor becomes the captive.

**v.35 — 185,000:** The overnight destruction of the Assyrian army is narrated with devastating understatement: "they rose early... and behold — all of them were dead corpses." The narrator gives no details of the angel's action, only its result. The silence is the horror.

*— EMET*
